draft.heroMessage: Montana's Go-Getter for Real Estate Success
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I’m Leland Reed, serving Whitefish, Missoula, and communities throughout western Montana. Whether you’re buying, selling, or relocating, let’s make your journey both successful and enjoyable.
draft.tagline: Making People Happy—One Home at a Time.
draft.aboutParagraph: Known for my warm, empathetic approach and tenacious deal-making, I strive to turn real estate dreams into reality for every client. With over $40M sold last year and a reputation as one of Montana’s top-performing agents, I combine market knowledge with a true passion for connecting people to their perfect home. From first-time homebuyers to seasoned investors, your needs always come first.
draft.conciergeLine: Questions about your next move in Montana? Text or call and I’ll help you navigate every step.
draft.contactLine: Reach out at (406) 207-2727 or Leland@revel.realestate. I look forward to hearing from you!
draft.tone: warm, approachable, and service-oriented with emphasis on community and client happiness

sections.title: Zillow has been working to transform the real estate experience since 2006.
sections.body: Advocating for consumers is core to who we are and why we exist. We were the first to put an estimated value over every roof in America, bringing home values out of the dark with the Zestimate®. We offer innovative products and support public policies to make homeownership more accessible.

sections.title: Get to know Leland Reed
sections.body: Real Estate Agent Leland Reed loves people, and it’s clear to see why. items.description: Welcome home to The Enclave Apartment Homes, located in gorgeous San Jose, California! At The Enclave Apartments you will find a community of distinction with flourishing neighborhoods, and a convenient location. Our community offers studio, one and two bedroom homes featuring built in closet shelving, custom wood cabinetry, gourmet kitchen, washer and dryer, ceilings fans and high ceilings in select units. In custom homes you may find a fireplace with a marble hearth, and spectacular views. Relax in luxury with our two heated pools or two soothing spas. We offer spectacular amenities like two lighted tennis courts, a gated entrance with controlled access, a media center with a large screen TV, and a jogging trail. Tour our photo gallery or call us to schedule your personal tour and let us show you why The Enclave is the perfect place to call home.
